fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2019 by $99.3 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: States 'do not hold any derivative financial instruments'. No fuel derivative activity since 2015.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed 470,939 [2019] 412,256 [2018] [from 2019 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense decreased by 14.3% from $939.2 million in 2018 to $804.3 million in 2019 due to 14.2% increase in fuel gallons consumed.
